The spec is written and lints clean at 100/100, but I haven't written any code yet. It needs your approval first.

**Spec:** `forgemyspec-bundle/note-taker/spec.yaml`. It's a spec-only bundle, with no Dafny, since nothing here is security- or money-critical.

| Obligation | Kind | What the test checks |
|---|---|---|
| `new_writes_note` | boundary | `new` writes a `.md` file with YAML frontmatter into `~/.note-taker/` |
| `list_search` | boundary | `list` filters by tag and by keyword, case-insensitive, in title or body |
| `show_edit` | boundary | `show` prints the note; `edit` runs `$EDITOR` on the file |
| `delete_and_errors` | boundary | `delete` removes the file; unknown ids and ids containing path separators exit non-zero without touching files |
| `single_file_stdlib` | boundary | `note_taker.py` imports only standard-library modules |

**Assumptions you're approving:**
- `NOTE_TAKER_DIR` overrides the notes directory, which lets the tests use a temp dir.
- Frontmatter is a small YAML subset that the tool writes and parses itself, because the standard library has no YAML parser. The fields are `title`, `tags`, `created` and `updated`.
- A note's id is the file name slug taken from its title.
- `edit` opens `$EDITOR`, falling back to `vi`.
- `list --tag` matches a tag exactly. `list --search` is a case-insensitive keyword match.

The implementation will only touch `note_taker.py` and `tests/**`.

**To approve, type this code in the chat: `PA5CVQ`.** After that I'll implement and run the gate.
